source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_execution_profile.py tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_review_transport.py

claims.claim: Execution profile policy and provider-neutral profile contract/resolver exist for Codex and Antigravity, preserve TASK-061 defaults, reject malformed policy/profile data, and create no model router or semantic authority.
Codex and Antigravity adapters consume injected profile values across PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR while preserving existing timeout, sandbox, schema, and ResultPackage contracts.
Focused regression coverage verifies synthetic future model identifiers and alternate valid effort reach exact command construction without allowlists, and invalid effort fails before invocation.
Every canonical Codex/Antigravity invocation persists an immutable execution-profile sidecar before runner entry, and executor/profile mismatch or conflicting sidecars invoke zero native runners.
Profile persistence is deterministic and idempotent, later policy changes cannot alter already-bound RUN profiles, and failure paths preserve attempted profile provenance.
Terminal transport includes optional execution-profile provenance with idempotent checks while historical terminals without profiles remain valid and readable.
No-native-invocation paths create no misleading profile sidecars and Antigravity MiniMax native execution path is exercised without creating execution profiles.
Human-facing CLI and carrier/dispatch selection semantics remain unchanged with production defaults preserved at gpt-5.6-sol/high and gemini-3.8-flash/high.
Frozen kernel, sandbox/mutation authority, Runtime verification, Reviewer, Publisher, roadmap, and no-retry boundaries remain unchanged.
